title: A new organization's first job posts without any mapping set up
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new organization created on the build.
  • Enable AccountingHub for the new organization.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. Open Accounting > Accounting Events.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Stock parts note names 6500 Vehicle Expenses, with no "No account set" warning.

Step 3:

  • The work order is Closed.

Step 4:

  • The Close is posted, not Held.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11763 (Story 6, AccountingHub account mapping), story SV-12295 (Story 13, Release day, seeding and migration)

  • S6-R2: “Automatically set up the starting category mappings using AccountingHub's existing chart of accounts. General Internal defaults to 6500 Vehicle Expenses, already in the default chart. Warranty and Goodwill both default to 6430 Warranty & Goodwill Expense, already in the newer chart. Comeback defaults to 6440 Comeback Expense, a new required account (number confirmed by the AccountingHub owner on 2026-11-09). The existing 6400 Shop Equipment Maintenance account remains available for accountants to select where appropriate; it is not an additional starting category. The mapping key should allow a kind (parts, labor) later, so V2 adds rows instead of changing the contract.”
  • S13-R4: “Every step is safe to run again: a rerun creates no duplicate category, row, account or mapping and overwrites nothing a shop has changed. The steps run before the release is visible to users, in this order: categories, QuickBooks rows, hub accounts and mappings.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
